text: This solution, New Zealand Government Landslide Risk Financing Initiatives (2020–2025) addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in New Zealand between Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment (MBIE), GNS Science, National Emergency Management Agency (NEMA), Toka Tū Ake EQC, Christchurch City Council, Insurance Council of New Zealand (ICNZ), NZGS/BRANZ, and Universities. The program was implemented in 2020 and focuses on collaboration and regulation.
